help_controls:
Left mouse button in Paint mode: Place the selected tile or spawn
Right mouse button in Paint mode: Erase a placement
Middle mouse button in Paint mode: Pick a tile or spawn from the board
Left mouse button in Inspect mode: Select a placement for editing
Mouse wheel over the board: Zoom
Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y: Undo/redo
Ctrl+O: Open a level
Ctrl+S: Save
F6: Start a playtest or hotload changes
Hold F6: Stop the playtest
about_description: LitterBox is a community-made level editor for Mewgenics, designed to make creating, editing, and playtesting vanilla and modded levels simple and easy!
about_disclaimer: LitterBox is NOT an official tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developers. Any levels remain the work of their respective authors!
credit_game: Special thanks to Edmund McMillen and Tyler Glaiel for creating such an amazing game!
playtest_note:
NOTE: You can hotload level changes at any time while the game is running!
